title: On an ω-Riemann-Liouville Fractional Differential Equation on an Infinite Interval
content: We investigate the existence and multiplicity of positive solutions for an ω-Riemann-Liouville fractional differential equation on an infinite interval supplemented with nonlocal boundary conditions containing Riemann-Stieltjes integrals and ω-Riemann-Liouville fractional derivatives of various orders. In the proof of our main results we use the Guo-Krasnosel’skii fixed point theorem and the Leggett-Williams fixed point theorem.
